settings.modeLowest: Drop a set number of lowest matches
settings.keepBestHint: Leave blank to count every match.
settings.onlySessionCountedLabel: Only use matches counted in a session ranking
settings.minimumHint: Teams with fewer counted matches get zeroes for the rest. 0 means no minimum.
